title: National Association for the Advancement of Colored People, et al. v. X.AI Corp., et al.
court: U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Mississippi, Oxford Division

plaintiffs: Mississippi State Conference of the NAACP

summary: Plaintiffs allege that defendants installed and operated gas turbines at a Southaven power facility serving Memphis-area data-center infrastructure without required preconstruction and operating permits. They seek injunctive relief, civil penalties, pollution controls, and other relief. The allegations have not been adjudicated.
coreQuestion: Did the turbine installation and operation trigger Clean Air Act permitting requirements, and were the sources improperly segmented or characterized?

plaintiffs: The turbines allegedly constitute a major source or aggregated project requiring permits.
The alleged emissions burden nearby communities and implicate environmental-justice concerns.
defendants: No merits response has been summarized in this seed record; consult the docket for filed defenses.

analysis.importance: Tests how legacy air-permitting systems apply to rapidly deployed AI-compute infrastructure.
uncertainties: No liability finding has been entered.
